threads.title: ready-time prompt whose socket closes before the turn starts is confirmed and strands the task (dead locator kept; slot leaked at cap 1, task orphaned at cap>=2; architect hears only worker-queued)

awaitTurnStart's get_state-failed branch ignores receipt.hasStarted: a start that raced the failing get_state is counted as a prompt failure and publishes a spurious worker-queued before the late commit corrects it

keyFindings.description: workerReady's PromptNotStarted catch confirms the boot and queues the task for a `socket closed` observation too; onWorkerClientClosed snapshotted confirmed=false before that, so its reconnect failure routes to retireUnconfirmedBoot, which no-ops on the now-set readyConfirmedAt. Reproduced (/tmp/legion-60-repro/ready-close.test.ts, REPRO_CAP=1 and 2): dead locator kept, pendingAssignment kept, queue entry dropped as stale at cap 2 / drain stuck at stop at cap 1, only worker-queued published. Required: a closed socket on the ready path must end with the locator cleared and the task relaunched (structured not-started reason handled by the close path, and/or onWorkerClientClosed re-reading readyConfirmedAt at retireDead time), plus a regression test at cap 1 and 2.
awaitTurnStart returns not-started from the get_state catch without checking receipt.hasStarted (line 812-816), unlike line 817. Fix in the same push.

A worker whose OMP keeps acking without a turn loops retire -> cold relaunch (fresh promptFailures; confirmBoot deletes launchFailures) forever with no worker-died/launch-failed; pre-existing for refusals. Also: the first turn-start after a prompt is credited to it even if an Envoy-routed message started the turn; OMP's prompt_result agentInvoked:false / late success:false are unconsumed definitive negatives. Architect to file as a LEGION issue.
